answer: The strongest lever is simple: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because inlet only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, copper is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
